worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.summary: Hold the nozzle to run a thin beam that connects to the real point it first touches along free aim. The shot on the first tick deals damage and may flood Sp. Atk back; keep the beam on the same target until it settles and the tail bites once more. Overcharge raises power and range.
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.use.0: Hold a thin beam on one target and make it stand in the line
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.use.1: Take one surge roll on the opening hit to bank Sp. Atk
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.use.2: Chip a weak point at mid-to-long range with the beam
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.description: Runs a thin beam from the nozzle along free aim up to %2$s blocks; the first body or wall cuts it off and the first enemy hit takes about %1$s special damage. Front ranks and walls block the beam, and firing into open air is allowed.

The beam has a %1$s-block radius; on the opening-tick hit, a %2$s chance for the residual current to flow back, raising the user's Sp. Atk by %3$s stage(s). A target swept later never receives a second full hit.

Keep the beam on the same struck target for %2$s s after the hit and the residual current bites once more on settle for %1$s of the main hit's damage; turning away, the target leaving, or a wall breaking the beam loses it.
Overcharge: 5 ticks more windup and a longer cooldown, but range ×1.2, power ×1.2, a higher surge chance and denser arcs.
Quick shot: shorter and cheaper, with shorter range, power ×0.9 and a lower surge chance.
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.chargebeam.growth.1: Lv.%1$s: beam damage %2$s, the surge raises %3$s Sp. Atk stage.
On: 5 ticks more wind-up and a longer cooldown, but range ×1.2, power ×1.2, a higher surge chance and denser arcs. Off (quick shot): shorter and cheaper, with shorter range, power ×0.9 and a lower surge chance.

On: while Sp. Atk is below +4 stages, rank the beam higher to bank that stage first. Off: never chase the buff on purpose.
